title: Create Meeting Link and Share in Chat
description: Teams Meet ekranında toplantı linki oluşturup belirli bir kişiye sohbette gönderme akışı

steps.action: Click the Meet section in the left sidebar
Click 'Create and copy link' to copy the invitation URL
Go to Chat and open the target person's conversation
Focus the message input and paste the copied link with Ctrl+V
Send the message (Enter or Send button)

expectedResult: Meeting link is created and sent to the selected person in chat
